choice_prompt:8:1810360006.text: <style="highlight">I can't remember a thing before I came to Novaris</style>. From the moment I had memory, I've been working for Baba.
choice_prompt:8:1810360006.source_cn: <style=highlight>我只记得来到诺珐斯以后的事</style>，从有记忆开始，我就在给婆婆工作了。

say:10:1810360008:1.text: Baba, please tell me the truth.
say:10:1810360008:1.source_cn: 婆婆，到底是怎么回事？你就告诉我吧。

say:11:1810360009:1.text: You are... <style="highlight">a Lightbearer war captive, meant to be converted into a Graveborn to serve Bantus in due time</style>...

say:13:1810360011:1.text: How did I lose my memory? You always told me it was a side effect of becoming a Graveborn...
say:13:1810360011:1.source_cn: 那我为什么会失忆？以前你都说是因为我变成了亡灵……

say:14:1810360012:1.text: Your memory was erased so you would forget your former life and devote yourself entirely to Bantus.
say:14:1810360012:1.source_cn: 洗去记忆，遗忘生前的一切，才能更好地为班题斯效力。

say:15:1810360013:1.text: I don't know exactly how it was done.
say:15:1810360013:1.source_cn: 至于具体方法，老身也不清楚。

choice_prompt:16:1810360013.text: I don't know exactly how it was done.
choice_prompt:16:1810360013.source_cn: 至于具体方法，老身也不清楚。

say:17:1810360014:1.text: Who cares about that right now? Saving Rain is our priority!
say:17:1810360014:1.source_cn: 这有何重要？！当务之急是救里纳！
say:17:1810360014:1.male: Who cares about that right now? Saving Rain is our priority!
say:17:1810360014:1.female: Who cares about that right now? Saving Rain is our priority!

say:18:1810360015:1.source_cn: 被赤烛蕊感染……不是不治之症吗？

say:19:1810360016:1.text: I don't know the cure, but <style="highlight">Lady Novaris</style> may know what to do...

say:20:1810360017:0.text: Lady Novaris once employed human servants at her estate, and some of them survived candle blossom infection. Her Ladyship must know how to treat it.
say:20:1810360017:0.source_cn: 十几年前，领主阁下的庄园内仍有生者血仆。老身曾亲眼见其...

say:21:1810360018:1.text: Rain, hang in there. I'll see her right away to get the cure for you!
say:21:1810360018:1.source_cn: 里纳，你要撑住。老身这就去面见领主，一定为你求来解药！

say:22:1810360019:1.text: Eveline needs it too! Baba, please help her. She's already passed out...
say:22:1810360019:1.source_cn: 艾芙琳也需要……！婆婆，你救救她吧，她已经昏厥了……

say:23:1810360020:1.text: It's up to the God of Death whether she can last until I get back.
say:23:1810360020:1.source_cn: 那就向死神祈求，但愿她能撑到老身回来吧。

say:24:1810360021:0.text: Meeting the ruler of Novaris is a great opportunity to learn something useful about Bantus!
say:24:1810360021:0.source_cn: 面见诺珐斯的领主——这是刺探情报的绝佳机会！如果幸运的...

say:25:1810360022:0.text: Douglas mentioned that <style="highlight">Lady Novaris once lived in the Gravebloom Fields</style>. Furthermore, <style="highlight">the danger posed by the candle blossoms appears to have been deliberately concealed</style>... Lady Novaris must have some connection to all of this.

choice_prompt:26:1810360022.text: Douglas mentioned that <style="highlight">Lady Novaris once lived in the Gravebloom Fields</style>. Furthermore, <style="highlight">the danger posed by the candle blossoms appears to have been deliberately concealed</style>... Lady Novaris must have some connection to all of this.
choice_prompt:26:1810360022.source_cn: 而且道格尔还曾言明，<style=highlight>苍骸花海是旧日领主庄园的所在地</style>，加之<style=highlight>被刻意隐瞒的赤烛蕊的危害</style>……这一切必定和诺珐斯领主脱不开干系。

say:27:1810360023:1.text: Fine. If the worst happens to me, you'll be able to bring the cure back.
say:27:1810360023:1.source_cn: 也罢。若是老身出了意外，至少你能把药剂带回来。
say:27:1810360023:1.male: Fine. If the worst happens to me, you'll be able to bring the cure back.
say:27:1810360023:1.female: Fine. If the worst happens to me, you'll be able to bring the cure back.

say:28:1810360024:0.text: Come. We're going to the <style="highlight">Seasong Theater</style>. The show just ended, and knowing Lady Novaris, she'll probably be hanging around there for a while.
say:28:1810360024:0.male: Come. We're going to the <style="highlight">Seasong Theater</style>. The show just ended, and knowing Lady Novaris, she'll probably be hanging around there for a while.
say:28:1810360024:0.female: Come. We're going to the <style="highlight">Seasong Theater</style>. The show just ended, and knowing Lady Novaris, she'll probably be hanging around there for a while.

choice:16:0:1.text: A human can be directly converted into a Graveborn?!
choice:16:0:1.source_cn: 班题斯还能将生者转化为亡灵？
choice:16:0:1.male: A human can be directly converted into a Graveborn?!
choice:16:0:1.female: A human can be directly converted into a Graveborn?!

choice:8:0:1.text: Baba, you owe Rain an explanation.
choice:8:0:1.male: Baba, you owe Rain an explanation.
choice:8:0:1.female: Baba, you owe Rain an explanation.

choice:8:1:2.text: No wonder you were so shocked when you found out.
choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 难怪你发现的时候那么惊讶
choice:8:1:2.male: No wonder you were so shocked when you found out.
choice:8:1:2.female: No wonder you were so shocked when you found out.

choice:8:2:3.text: I know how you feel. I lost my memory too.
choice:8:2:3.source_cn: 同病相怜，我也经常失忆
choice:8:2:3.male: I know how you feel. I lost my memory too.
choice:8:2:3.female: I know how you feel. I lost my memory too.

choice:6:0:1.text: Wait, you don't even know who you are?
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 等等，你连自己是谁都不知道？
choice:6:0:1.male: Wait, you don't even know who you are?
choice:6:0:1.female: Wait, you don't even know who you are?

say:0:1810361001:0.text: Lady Novaris should be at the Seasong Theater. Come on, let's go.
say:0:1810361001:0.source_cn: 领主阁下此刻必定还在海歌剧院，快随老身动身吧。
say:0:1810361001:0.male: Lady Novaris should be at the Seasong Theater. Come on, let's go.
say:0:1810361001:0.female: Lady Novaris should be at the Seasong Theater. Come on, let's go.

say:2:1810363002:0.text: Baba Muriel from the Repair House. You aren't exactly a regular here.
say:2:1810363002:0.source_cn: 修缮屋的穆婆婆。你可不是海歌剧场的常客。

say:3:1810363003:1.text: Are you here for Senea? I'm afraid you've missed the show.
say:3:1810363003:1.source_cn: 特地为塞涅而来吗？迟到得太久了吧。

say:4:1810363004:1.text: I'm here to see you, Your Ladyship.

say:6:1810363006:1.text: I've got a patient infected by candle blossom at my clinic...
say:6:1810363006:1.source_cn: 修缮屋里，有人被赤烛蕊感染……

say:7:1810363007:1.text: That assistant of yours with long blonde hair?
say:7:1810363007:1.source_cn: 你那位留着金色长发的员工？

say:8:1810363008:1.text: N-Not him. It's a human patient.
say:8:1810363008:1.source_cn: 不……不是。是一位病人，是生者。

say:9:1810363009:1.text: Tsk, tsk, tsk, the bulging veins on the back of your hand have given you away. How audacious of you to lie to me.
say:9:1810363009:1.source_cn: 瞧瞧你手背上的青筋，既然如此紧张，为何还敢在余面前撒谎？

say:10:1810363010:1.text: Do you truly think your pathetic spell can fool me? Even those Lightbearer stowaways make more convincing Graveborn than the young human you're trying to hide.
say:10:1810363010:1.source_cn: 那年轻的生者不过是被你用拙劣的魔法做了一番遮掩，伪装程...

say:12:1810363012:1.text: Look at you, trembling like a leaf. Relax, alright? Your flesh may be nice and chewy, but it's nowhere near fresh enough for my liking.
say:12:1810363012:1.source_cn: 瞧你怕成了什么样？你身上的肉嚼劲虽足，但鲜度太差劲了。

say:13:1810363013:1.text: So, you want to save him?

say:15:1810363015:0.text: And I can't be bothered to ask why. Still, you've interrupted my afternoon tea, and that's not without consequences.
say:15:1810363015:0.source_cn: 嗯……理由余懒得追究，但你打搅了余的下午茶，总该付出些代价。

say:16:1810363016:1.text: Your companion is a new face. Your new assistant?
say:16:1810363016:1.source_cn: 你身边那个亡灵好面生啊。新员工？
say:16:1810363016:1.male: Your companion is a new face. Your new assistant?
say:16:1810363016:1.female: Your companion is a new face. Your new assistant?

choice_prompt:17:1810363016.text: Your companion is a new face. Your new assistant?
choice_prompt:17:1810363016.source_cn: 你身边那个亡灵好面生啊。新员工？
choice_prompt:17:1810363016.male: Your companion is a new face. Your new assistant?
choice_prompt:17:1810363016.female: Your companion is a new face. Your new assistant?

say:18:1810363017:1.text: He's working for me until he pays off his medical bills.
say:18:1810363017:1.male: He's working for me until he pays off his medical bills.
say:18:1810363017:1.female: She's working for me until she pays off her medical bills.

say:19:1810363018:1.text: Working off your bills? How hilarious. Looks like you'll never free yourself from the Repair House.
say:19:1810363018:1.source_cn: 打工？哈哈哈哈——恭喜呀，那你可要工作到“死”了。
say:19:1810363018:1.male: Working off your bills? How hilarious. Looks like you'll never free yourself from the Repair House.
say:19:1810363018:1.female: Working off your bills? How hilarious. Looks like you'll never free yourself from the Repair House.

say:20:1810363019:1.text: Baba Muriel, if you want the antidote, bring me <style="highlight">a glass of his blood</style>.
say:20:1810363019:1.male: Baba Muriel, if you want the antidote, bring me <style="highlight">a glass of his blood</style>.
say:20:1810363019:1.female: Baba Muriel, if you want the antidote, bring me <style="highlight">a glass of her blood</style>.

choice_prompt:21:1810363019.text: Baba Muriel, if you want the antidote, bring me <style="highlight">a glass of his blood</style>.
choice_prompt:21:1810363019.source_cn: 那么，不如这样吧。让<male>他</male><female>她</female><style=highlight>给余一杯血</style>，余会考虑赐予感染的解药。
choice_prompt:21:1810363019.male: Baba Muriel, if you want the antidote, bring me <style="highlight">a glass of his blood</style>.
choice_prompt:21:1810363019.female: Baba Muriel, if you want the antidote, bring me <style="highlight">a glass of her blood</style>.

say:22:1810363020:1.text: Right, maybe I should take one of your arms instead. What do you think?
say:22:1810363020:1.source_cn: 没错，完全没用，你提醒余了。那换一条胳膊来，怎么样？
say:22:1810363020:1.male: Right, maybe I should take one of your arms instead. What do you think?
say:22:1810363020:1.female: Right, maybe I should take one of your arms instead. What do you think?

choice_prompt:23:1810363020.text: Right, maybe I should take one of your arms instead. What do you think?
choice_prompt:23:1810363020.source_cn: 没错，完全没用，你提醒余了。那换一条胳膊来，怎么样？
choice_prompt:23:1810363020.male: Right, maybe I should take one of your arms instead. What do you think?
choice_prompt:23:1810363020.female: Right, maybe I should take one of your arms instead. What do you think?

say:25:1810363024:1.text: I've never been denied anything I wanted.
say:25:1810363024:1.source_cn: 余想要的东西，从没有拿不到手的。

choice:23:0:1.text: Whatever you want, just take it...
choice:23:0:1.male: Whatever you want, just take it...
choice:23:0:1.female: Whatever you want, just take it...

choice:21:0:1.text: Why do you want a Graveborn's blood?
choice:21:0:1.male: Why do you want a Graveborn's blood?
choice:21:0:1.female: Why do you want a Graveborn's blood?

say:27:1810363021:1.text: You became a Graveborn only recently, didn't you? You smell... delicious.
say:27:1810363021:1.source_cn: 你刚变成亡灵吧？闻起来……很美味。
say:27:1810363021:1.male: You became a Graveborn only recently, didn't you? You smell... delicious.
say:27:1810363021:1.female: You became a Graveborn only recently, didn't you? You smell... delicious.

say:28:1810363022:1.text: Very well. Then you can forget about the antidote.
say:28:1810363022:1.source_cn: 好呀，那么余也只能拒绝赐予你等解药了。
say:28:1810363022:1.male: Very well. Then you can forget about the antidote.
say:28:1810363022:1.female: Very well. Then you can forget about the antidote.

choice:17:1:2.text: I'm working off my medical bills.
choice:17:1:2.source_cn: 算是吧，我在打工还诊费
choice:17:1:2.male: I'm working off my medical bills.
choice:17:1:2.female: I'm working off my medical bills.

narration:0:1810364001:1.text: An empty goblet floats over to you.
narration:0:1810364001:1.male: An empty goblet floats over to you.
narration:0:1810364001:1.female: An empty goblet floats over to you.

narration:1:1810364002:1.text: You steel yourself and cut your palm.
narration:1:1810364002:1.male: You steel yourself and cut your palm.
narration:1:1810364002:1.female: You steel yourself and cut your palm.

narration:2:1810364003:1.text: You expect blood to drip from your wound, but Graveborn do not bleed. Instead, it drifts into the goblet in an unfathomable manner.
narration:2:1810364003:1.male: You expect blood to drip from your wound, but Graveborn do not bleed. Instead, it drifts into the goblet in an unfathomable manner.
narration:2:1810364003:1.female: You expect blood to drip from your wound, but Graveborn do not bleed. Instead, it drifts into the goblet in an unfathomable manner.

say:1:1810365001:1.text: Heh, a rare prize has stumbled right into my path.

say:3:1810365003:1.text: Be patient. Surely you don't expect me to carry around all those bottles and vials.
say:3:1810365003:1.source_cn: 别着急。余出门懒得随身携带那么多瓶瓶罐罐。

say:4:1810365004:1.text: But luckily for you, I happen to have the ingredient close at hand.
say:4:1810365004:1.source_cn: 不过你们很幸运，这里刚好有解药的原料。

say:6:1810365005:1.text: With a flick of her wrist, Tephesia conjures a blood-red moth out of thin air.
say:6:1810365005:1.source_cn: 苔佩希转动手腕，一只血红色的飞蛾便凭空出现，上下飞舞。

say:7:1810365006:1.text: The next second, a green beam shatters the moth, reducing it to dust. The crimson particles fall into a vial that appears out of nowhere, mixing with the liquid inside to form a strange potion.
say:7:1810365006:1.source_cn: 下一秒钟，一道青绿色的光束击碎了它，红色的粉末落入一个...

say:9:1810365007:1.text: Here you go. Take the scenic route on your way back. The potion could use a bit more mixing.
say:9:1810365007:1.source_cn: 拿去吧，路上走慢一点，多欣赏欣赏诺珐斯的美景，也正好摇匀。

choice_prompt:10:1810365007.text: Here you go. Take the scenic route on your way back. The potion could use a bit more mixing.
choice_prompt:10:1810365007.source_cn: 拿去吧，路上走慢一点，多欣赏欣赏诺珐斯的美景，也正好摇匀。

say:11:1810365008:1.text: Baba Muriel, keep your assistant in line. Such a tone is unbecoming when addressing me.
say:11:1810365008:1.source_cn: 穆婆婆，管好你的员工，这可不是该对领主说话的语气。
say:11:1810365008:1.male: Baba Muriel, keep your assistant in line. Such a tone is unbecoming when addressing me.
say:11:1810365008:1.female: Baba Muriel, keep your assistant in line. Such a tone is unbecoming when addressing me.

say:12:1810365009:0.text: One more insolent remark from him, and I'll use his blood to water my garden.
say:12:1810365009:0.male: One more insolent remark from him, and I'll use his blood to water my garden.
say:12:1810365009:0.female: One more insolent remark from her, and I'll use her blood to water my garden.

say:13:1810365010:1.text: T-Thank you for your mercy, Your Ladyship... I'll make sure to teach him some manners once we get back.
say:13:1810365010:1.source_cn: 是、是，感谢您的仁慈……老身回去一定好好管教<male...
say:13:1810365010:1.male: T-Thank you for your mercy, Your Ladyship... I'll make sure to teach him some manners once we get back.
say:13:1810365010:1.female: T-Thank you for your mercy, Your Ladyship... I'll make sure to teach her some manners once we get back.

choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 领主阁下，我们需要更多

say:0:1810366001:0.text: Thank heavens Her Ladyship didn't hold it against us... The antidote should be enough.
say:0:1810366001:0.source_cn: 幸好领主阁下没有与修缮屋计较……药剂的分量够用。
say:0:1810366001:0.male: Thank heavens Her Ladyship didn't hold it against us... The antidote should be enough.
say:0:1810366001:0.female: Thank heavens Her Ladyship didn't hold it against us... The antidote should be enough.

say:1:1810366002:0.text: Quick, let's head back. Rain and that girl are waiting for us.
say:1:1810366002:0.source_cn: 快与老身回去，救治里纳和那丫头吧。
say:1:1810366002:0.male: Quick, let's head back. Rain and that girl are waiting for us.
say:1:1810366002:0.female: Quick, let's head back. Rain and that girl are waiting for us.

say:3:1810367002:1.text: Wow... to what do I owe this honor? Shouldn't you be at King Thoran's side, serving as <style="highlight">his most loyal Imperial Guard Commander</style>?

say:4:1810367003:1.text: And where's that adorable little horse of yours? I'm surprised you actually left it outside. Afraid it might crack the theater steps under its weight?
say:4:1810367003:1.source_cn: 你那匹走到哪都要骑着的可爱马驹呢？为何不带进来，是怕它...

say:5:1810367004:1.text: Speaking like that only makes you look like a clown.
say:5:1810367004:1.source_cn: 如果你不准备到台上扮小丑，就别用那种口气和我说话。

say:6:1810367005:0.text: Loosen up, <style="highlight">Grezhul</style>. Even if King Thoran ordered the theater to be turned into a circus, I'd spare your little horse from the stage.

say:7:1810367006:1.text: So, what exactly brings you here?
say:7:1810367006:1.source_cn: 所以，拜见余是为了何事？

say:8:1810367007:1.text: When will the <style="highlight">Soul Forge</style> be ready for use? His Majesty wants an update.
say:8:1810367007:1.source_cn: 陛下要知道<style=highlight>亡灵转化器...

say:9:1810367008:1.text: This is the eighty-seventh time His Majesty has asked about it. Hasn't he grown tired of asking by now?
say:9:1810367008:1.source_cn: 陛下已经派人来问过八十七次了，还没问够吗？

say:11:1810367010:1.text: As I've said countless times before, the construction was completed long ago, but the Soul Forge cannot be activated without the item I previously mentioned to His Majesty.
say:11:1810367010:1.source_cn: 余的回答和之前相同：建造工作早已完成，但启动它需要余曾...

say:12:1810367011:1.text: His Majesty has agreed to provide you with the item you require.
say:12:1810367011:1.source_cn: 陛下已经许诺，给你提供启动装置所需的东西。

say:13:1810367012:1.text: Oh, is that so? Where is it?
say:13:1810367012:1.source_cn: 是吗？在哪？余怎么没有看见？

say:14:1810367013:1.text: It's right in front of you.

say:17:1810367016:1.text: Hahahaha! His Majesty is sacrificing your soul for his own cause, and you're taking it so calmly?
say:17:1810367016:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈！他要永久征用你的灵魂，你就这么坦然接受了？

say:18:1810367017:1.text: It's because lazy, inferior souls like yours are unworthy of serving His Majesty.
say:18:1810367017:1.source_cn: 堕怠低等的灵魂不配被陛下使用——比如你这蠢货。

say:19:1810367018:1.text: You now have everything you need. Activate the Soul Forge at once. His Majesty is running out of patience.
say:19:1810367018:1.source_cn: 你要的东西已经齐备，立刻启动亡灵转化器，陛下已经不想再等了。

say:21:1810367020:1.text: Tsk... No more slacking off for me, I guess.
say:21:1810367020:1.source_cn: 好吧……看来余这懒惰之人，也不得不打起精神了。

say:4:1810325001:0.text: You activate the magic circle with the last of your mana. Thanks to the abundant leyline magic, the candle blossoms wrapped around the girl slowly wither away, leaving behind the parts that have embedded in her skin.
say:4:1810325001:0.source_cn: 你用仅存的魔力启动了魔法阵，幸而这片土地中的魔力还算充...
say:4:1810325001:0.male: You activate the magic circle with the last of your mana. Thanks to the abundant leyline magic, the candle blossoms wrapped around the girl slowly wither away, leaving behind the parts that have embedded in her skin.
